_note: Draft pathways for the demo. Exam dates were researched on 2026-11-21 from news and education sites (not official notices) and some sources disagree: always confirm on the official exam site. Have a working professional check each pathway before showing it to real students.

ux-designer.streamNote: Any stream works: design entrance exams like UCEED and NID DAT accept students from all streams.
examTimeline: NID DAT 2027 prelims: reported for about 20 December 2026 (applications closed 30 November 2026)
UCEED 2027: exam on 17 January 2027 (registration ran October–November 2026)
Spring 2027: NID DAT mains (studio test and interview) and IIT B.Des seat allotment
degrees: Or any degree plus a strong UX portfolio

firstJobs: UX or UI designer at a startup or product company
Interaction designer at a design agency
growth: Senior designer, then design lead, then head of design
Or move into UX research or product management

tryThisWeek: Redesign one screen of an app your family finds confusing, on paper
Watch a free beginner UX course video online
Ask a grandparent to use an app while you watch silently and take notes

forensic-accountant.streamNote: CA is open to any stream, but Commerce (with Maths) makes it much easier.
exams: CA Foundation, then CA Intermediate and CA Final (ICAI)
examTimeline: CA Foundation January 2027 exams: 3, 5, 7 and 9 January 2027 (forms closed 16 November 2026)
ICAI holds CA Foundation more than once a year, so you can pick a later attempt after Class 12
Then CA Intermediate, 3 years of articleship, and CA Final
collegeTypes: ICAI coaching and articleship (no college needed for CA)

firstJobs: Auditor or article assistant at a CA firm
Analyst in a forensic or risk team at an audit firm
growth: Forensic accountant, then manager, then partner
Or fraud investigator for banks and regulators

tryThisWeek: Track your family's grocery spending for a week and look for surprises
Read one news story about a company fraud and list the warning signs
Try a free beginner accounting video online

urban-planner.streamNote: B.Plan usually needs Maths in Class 12, so Science with Maths (PCM) is the safest route.
exams: State and university planning entrance tests
examTimeline: JEE Main 2027 Session 1: late January 2027 (Paper 2B for B.Planning; reported dates vary)
After results: JoSAA counselling for planning seats at SPAs and NITs
degrees: Or B.Arch / Civil Engineering, then M.Plan

firstJobs: Junior planner at a planning consultancy
Planner at a city development authority or smart-city project
growth: Senior planner, then transport or urban design specialist
Or policy roles with government and NGOs

tryThisWeek: Map your route to school and mark every unsafe spot
Count how many vehicles pass a junction near you in 10 minutes
Look up your city's master plan or metro map online

architect.streamNote: B.Arch needs Physics, Chemistry and Maths in Class 12.
exams: JEE Main Paper 2A (B.Arch, for NITs and SPAs)
examTimeline: JEE Main 2027 Session 1: late January 2027 (Paper 2A for B.Arch; reported dates vary)
NATA 2027: several attempts in spring and summer (2027 dates not announced yet)
After results: JoSAA counselling for NITs and SPAs, state counselling for other colleges

firstJobs: Junior architect at a design studio
Site architect with a construction company
growth: Project architect, then associate, then your own practice
Or specialise in urban design, interiors or green buildings

tryThisWeek: Measure your home and draw its floor plan to scale on squared paper
Visit one building you love and sketch why it feels good
Watch a free intro video on sketching floor plans
